items.t: Honda Motor (TSE:7267) Recalls 810,592 US Vehicles And Unveils Avancier Hybrid SUV
items.sum: Honda Motor (TSE:7267) is recalling over 800,000 vehicles in the US due to airbag defects that may cause serious injury. Toyota is conducting a parallel recall in the US, covering additional vehicles over airbag and engine camshaft related risks.
